verdict.rationale: USCIS's public site offers a 'Check your case status' tool and a 'Case Status Online' page to 'track the status of an immigration application, petition, or request.' Online filers can also track their case through their account. The probe showing the egov host blocking automated agents concerns bot access, not a human founder using the public page, so it does not contradict the capability. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how the public lookup works (e.g., receipt-number entry and what status detail is shown), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the public status page working.
